children: Sweden investment company's Q3 NAV per share fell 27% due to Klarna share price drop
Q3 net loss deepened as operating profit turned negative
Company invested further in Klarna, made new investments, and sold part of SpaceX holding
Company did not provide specific guidance for future quarters or full-year results in its press release
KLARNA SHARE PRICE - Co said negative share price development in listed holding Klarna was main driver of Q3 value decline
DEFENSOR REVALUATION - Co said revaluation of unlisted holding Defensor increased NAV by about 413 mln SEK
SPACEX DIVESTMENT - Co said divestment of about one third of SpaceX holding generated gross sales proceeds of 54.6 mln SEK and gross profit of 44.7 mln SEK
